services.name: Private Bottom Fun Fishing Charter for Family and Friends
services.desc: Private Bottom Fishing Charter for Family and Friends. Maximum 6 guests. Fun for all ages. Set out from Kewalo Basin Harbor for a two hour bottom fishing charter where you are sure to catch fish. We are located in Honolulu near the Ala Moana Mall and within minutes of Waikiki. Please feel free to bring your own food and drinks for the trip-Ice chests will be available for your use. All necessary fishing gear will be provided for you. A daily briefing of our safety equipment and how to reel in your fish will get you ready for the adventure. We welcome you aboard with the Aloha spirit whether $475 includes up to 2 people • $75 for each additional guest • Maximum of 6 • 2 Hours

services.name: Private Sunset Boat Cruise in Waikiki
services.desc: Perfect way to end your day! Up to 2 Hours About Private Sunset tours for the perfect end to your day. Book with us to escape the crowds! The sunset tour is a great way to unwind on your vacation in paradise. Come with family, friends or bring your significant other for a romantic night for two. In addition to the beauty of the open ocean, famous Waikiki skyline, and the breathtaking sunset, keep on the lookout for whales, dolphins, and/or turtles. On Fridays we will go out to see the beautiful Waikiki fireworks display if conditions allow. Maximum of 6 people per trip-all ages $495 includes up to 2 people • $50 for each additional guest• Maximum of 6 • Up to 2 hours

services.name: Exclusive Charter
services.desc: Waikiki Sport Fishing offers daily half and full day sport fishing charters out of one of the island’s busiest fishing harbors! Times and Daily at 6am, 12pm, 1pm Full Day Charter (8 hours): $1,750 3/4 Day Charter (6 hours): $1,500 Half Day Charter (4 hours): $1,250 About Join us aboard the Renegade and cruise the majestic blue Pacific Ocean. Start your adventure at Kewalo Basin Harbor, just a few minutes from Waikiki, and join us in search of pelagic fish ranging from 5lbs to over 500lbs! Reel in a mahi mahi, ono, tuna and maybe even the powerful pacific blue marlin. Our fishing vessels Starting at $1,050 • Ages 6+ • Up to 6 people • 4, 6 and 8 hour charters

services.name: Half Day Shared Charter
services.desc: Our shared charters take up to six anglers, typically in groups of 1-3! Times and Daily at 6am, 12pm and 1pm 4 hour trip About At Kewalo Basin, most of the charter fishing companies work together to ensure everyone makes it out on the water. Unfortunately, we can’t guarantee your experience will be with us, but will say it’s a fun and affordable way to go fishing and meet other anglers from around the world.
